title: Bounded retry for PyPI release-date fetch in remove_experimental_decorators script
answers: CI fails intermittently when fetching MLflow release dates from PyPI
connection reset while the experimental decorator script downloads release metadata
how does get_mlflow_release_dates retry on transient network errors
PyPI 429 or 5xx causes the dev script to fail
body:
Symptom: CI job intermittently fails with a connection reset while the experimental-decorator cleanup script fetches MLflow release metadata from PyPI.
Root cause: dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py:get_mlflow_release_dates made a single urlopen call with no timeout and no retry, so any transient network failure aborted the run.
Fix pattern: loop up to 3 attempts around urlopen(..., timeout=10). Retry on URLError/TimeoutError/ConnectionError and on HTTPError with code 429 or 5xx; re-raise other HTTPErrors immediately; re-raise on the last attempt; sleep 2**attempt between attempts. Parse JSON only after the loop so invalid JSON fails immediately.
Constraints: HTTPError subclasses URLError, so the HTTPError handler must stay before the URLError handler or every HTTP error would be retried. Applies to this dev script's PyPI fetch; the retry policy is not a shared helper.
applies: Only the PyPI metadata fetch in dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py; other network calls in dev/ are not covered by this change.
says: Continuous integration fails intermittently during release metadata download from the package index.
Experimental decorator cleanup script crashes on network timeouts or transient connection resets.
Add automatic retries with exponential backoff when fetching package release dates.
Rate limiting errors from the package registry abort the developer cleanup workflow.
Prevent flaky build failures when external package registry requests experience temporary outages.
search: The PyPI release-date fetch in the experimental decorator cleanup script implements a bounded 3-attempt retry loop with exponential backoff. In dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py:get_mlflow_release_dates, urlopen runs with a 10-second timeout, retrying on TimeoutError, ConnectionError, URLError, or HTTPError codes 429 and 5xx while re-raising other HTTP errors immediately. Because HTTPError subclasses URLError, the HTTP handler must precede the URL handler; this unshared retry policy applies strictly to the PyPI fetch in this script.
